name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
grip: Pronated or slightly angled; wrists stacked above forearms.
description: A supported dumbbell press performed with your head lower than your hips. The chest drives the press while the triceps and front shoulders assist.
setup: Set a shallow decline and secure your legs using the bench supports.
Bring both dumbbells into position with a controlled entry; use assistance if needed.
instructions: Begin with dumbbells beside the lower chest, forearms near vertical and elbows moderately tucked.
Press upward until the weights are above the chest and arms are comfortably extended.
Lower slowly along the same path to a controlled, comfortable depth.
Finish by securing both weights before sitting up or leaving the bench.
cues: Keep head and upper back supported.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows widely or bending wrists back.
Bouncing at the bottom or twisting while getting out.

logging.example: Two 20 kg dumbbells: record 20 kg per dumbbell, not 40 kg.
